Catalogue entry — Writing box
Materials and surface: The rectangular body is formed from cedar panels joined at the corners. Its exterior is coated with black lacquer; small brass plates are fixed at the corners. The lid bears a design of reeds and waterfowl in gold powder applied over the lacquer.
Catalogue note: The metal is recorded as brass, and the surface decoration is described as sprinkled gold. The entry does not identify the lacquer recipe or the workshop.
